body.message:
Please note that Urban Oasis Building does not allow self check-in. As you will be arriving at 1:00 AM, we will need to arrange for a team member to assist you with the check-in.

Our standard operating hours are from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Since your arrival is outside our operating hours, an additional after-hours check-in fee of AED 500 will apply.
